provenance.source: Authored for v04-c02; no observed company, bank or market data
provenance.access: Included for offline reuse with the chapter
provenance.time: t=0 now; t=1,2,3 annual period ends
provenance.prices: All cash amounts use the same nominal-dollar convention; no inflation adjustment
provenance.boundary: Incremental cash flows before financing and taxes; no unpaid customer balances, debt, tax effects or intermediate capital purchases. Working capital is paid at t=0; its t=3 recovery is an explicit project input, equal to the original outlay in the base case.
